query: What subjects are offered in B.A. at NPGC?
answer: B.A. at NPGC offers subjects including History, Geography, Economics, Political Science, Hindi, English, Sociology, Psychology, Home Science, Sanskrit, and more. Subject combinations may vary as per course requirements.

query: What subjects are offered in B.Sc. at NPGC?
answer: B.Sc. at NPGC offers combinations in Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Botany, Zoology, and Computer Science. Students choose subject combinations at the time of admission.

query: What subjects are included in BCA curriculum at NPGC?
answer: BCA curriculum at NPGC includes subjects like Programming in C/C++/Java, Data Structures, Database Management, Web Development, Computer Networks, Software Engineering, and Mathematics.

query: What subjects are offered in B.Com at NPGC?
answer: B.Com at NPGC includes subjects such as Financial Accounting, Business Law, Income Tax, Auditing, Business Economics, Cost Accounting, Financial Management, and Computer Applications.

query: What are the subjects in M.A. at NPGC?
answer: M.A. at NPGC is offered in subjects like Economics, Hindi, History, English, Sociology, and Political Science. Students choose their specialization at the time of M.A. admission.

query: What subjects are included in BBA at NPGC?
answer: BBA curriculum at NPGC includes subjects like Business Management, Marketing Management, Financial Accounting, Human Resource Management, Entrepreneurship, Business Communication, and Economics.

query: What subjects are in M.Sc. at NPGC?
answer: M.Sc. at NPGC is offered in subjects including Chemistry. Students interested in M.Sc. programs can contact the Science department or check www.npgc.in for current program offerings.

query: What is the curriculum structure under NEP 2020 at NPGC?
answer: Under NEP 2020, NPGC follows a flexible multi-disciplinary curriculum structure including Major, Minor, and Vocational subjects along with skill enhancement courses, value-added courses, and research components.

query: Does NPGC offer vocational subjects?
answer: Yes, NPGC offers vocational subjects and B.Voc programs under the NSDC framework. These programs include specialized vocational training in various trades and industries.

query: Does NPGC offer physical education as a subject?
answer: NPGC has sports facilities and promotes physical education through NCC, NSS, and sports programs. For physical education as an academic subject, contact the college administration for current curriculum details.

query: What is the student strength at NPGC?
answer: NPGC is one of the largest colleges in Lucknow with thousands of students enrolled across various under-graduate and post-graduate programs in Arts, Commerce, Science, and Computer faculties.

query: Is NPGC a co-educational institution?
answer: Yes, NPGC is a co-educational institution welcoming both male and female students across all programs. The college provides a safe and inclusive learning environment for all students.

query: What is the medium of instruction at NPGC?
answer: The medium of instruction at NPGC is primarily Hindi and English. Some programs may have specific language requirements. Contact the department for details on the medium of instruction for your course.

query: What documents are required for admission at NPGC?
answer: Documents required for admission at NPGC include: 10th and 12th mark sheets, transfer certificate, migration certificate, caste certificate (if applicable), character certificate, passport-size photographs, and Aadhar card.

query: What is the minimum percentage required for BCA admission at NPGC?
answer: For BCA admission at NPGC, students generally need to have passed 12th standard with Mathematics or Computer Science. The exact eligibility percentage is available on the college website www.npgc.in.

query: Is there age limit for admission at NPGC?
answer: For admission age limits at NPGC, students should check the current year's admission guidelines on the official website www.npgc.in as age requirements may vary by course and university norms.

query: What is the examination pattern at NPGC?
answer: NPGC follows a semester-based examination pattern under its Autonomous status. Examinations include internal assessments (assignments, class tests) and semester-end written examinations.

query: How are internal assessments done at NPGC?
answer: Internal assessments at NPGC include class tests, assignments, presentations, attendance, and practical work. Internal marks typically constitute 20-30% of the total marks depending on the course.

query: Does NPGC library have e-books and digital resources?
answer: Yes, NPGC library provides access to N-LIST (National Library and Information Services Infrastructure for Scholarly Content) which includes thousands of e-books and e-journals for students and faculty.

query: Can I access NPGC library resources from home?
answer: Yes, NPGC students and faculty can access N-LIST digital library resources remotely using their registered credentials. The N-LIST database provides access to e-books and e-journals from home.

query: Does NPGC have a Student Union?
answer: NPGC has student representative bodies that work with the college administration to address student concerns and organize student welfare activities. Student elections are held as per university guidelines.

query: Does NPGC have an employment exchange registration facility?
answer: NPGC supports students in registering with the employment exchange for government job opportunities. Students can seek guidance from the Training and Placement Office for employment registration.
